artifacts.name: MANIFEST_HEADER_COMMENT
artifacts.description: Canonical ASCII-only, flush-left four-line comment banner stating what a manifest is, that it is not required to build or run the project, and the https://github.com/mamertofabian/maid-runner pointer. Each line starts with '#' and the text ends with a newline.

artifacts.name: prepend_manifest_header
artifacts.description: Return rendered YAML with MANIFEST_HEADER_COMMENT inserted flush-left above the first YAML key. Idempotent: returns rendered unchanged when the banner already appears in the leading comment block, detected by scanning only that block rather than the whole document so a manifest whose body quotes the banner still gets one, and comparing each line with trailing whitespace stripped so an editor-scuffed banner is still recognized rather than stacked. Inserts the banner immediately after a leading '# draft-kind:' or '# archive-kind:' marker line when one is present, otherwise at the very top. Makes no other modification to rendered.

artifacts.name: save_manifest
artifacts.description: Serialize a Manifest to YAML at path with the canonical header banner prepended, so the default maid snapshot output identifies itself. Key order and flow style are unchanged.

artifacts.name: _dump_manifest_yaml
artifacts.description: Render manifest YAML with human-reviewable string styles, then return it with the canonical manifest header banner prepended via prepend_manifest_header.

artifacts.name: write_from_diff_manifest
